headline: Colombian Peso Falls 1.83% as Central Bank Maintains Rate at 12.25%
summary: The Colombian peso fell 1.83% while the benchmark COLCAP index closed nearly flat, up 0.04% at 2,491, after the central bank held its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 12.25%.
why: Banco de la República sets monetary policy in Colombia, influencing borrowing costs, capital flows, and the exchange rate of the Colombian peso.
